The Nurse Manager for Acute Care at the James A. Haley Veterans' Hospital & Clinics is a frontline supervisory leader responsible for 24/7 oversight of assigned inpatient units, ensuring high-quality, Veteran-centered care.

The Nurse Manager provides clinical and administrative leadership, drives evidence-based practice, and fosters a culture of safety, engagement, and accountability. This role requires strong communication, team-building skills, and the ability to collaborate across interdisciplinary teams to achieve optimal Veteran outcomes.

Responsibilities include staff oversight, resource allocation, performance management, and participation in organizational initiatives to support nursing excellence.

Major duties include, but are not limited to: - Provides leadership, supervision, and 24/7 oversight for assigned Acute Care units including ICU, Progressive Care, STAT Team, Inpatient Case Management, Med-Surg Units, and Centralized Telemetry, with authority for both clinical and administrative operations. - Coordinates and evaluates patient care delivery using the full nursing process, ensuring high-quality, age-appropriate, Veteran-centered care. - Oversees staffing, develops schedules, validates data, and participates in staffing methodology processes. - Leads recruitment efforts, conducts interviews, and selects qualified candidates in coordination with the Nurse Recruiter. - Provides orientation, training, and ongoing competency development for staff; evaluates performance through proficiencies and appraisals. - Supports and drives evidence-based practice, quality improvement, and nurse-sensitive indicator performance, including data collection, analysis, trending, and reporting.- Ensures compliance with all accreditation and regulatory standards and maintains continual survey readiness. - Collaborates with interdisciplinary teams to remove barriers, enhance care processes, and implement innovative programs that improve Veteran outcomes. - Promotes an inclusive, culturally competent, and psychologically safe work environment aligned with organizational values, ethics, and EEO principles. - Participates in shared governance councils, organizational strategic planning, and the development of care delivery models. - Serves as a role model and servant leader, maintaining open communication with staff, peers, and union partners; conducts regular staff meetings with union invitations. - May provide cross-coverage within Acute Care and may be required to travel between hospital and clinic sites as needed.

VA offers a comprehensive total rewards package: VA Nurse Total Rewards Pay: Competitive salary, regular salary increases, potential for performance awards Paid Time Off: 50 days of paid time off per year (26 days of annual leave, 13 days of sick leave, 11 paid Federal holidays per year) Retirement: Traditional federal pension (5 years vesting) and federal 401K with up to 5% in contributions by VA Insurance: Federal health/vision/dental/term life/long-term care (many federal insurance programs can be carried into retirement) Licensure: 1 full and unrestricted license from any US State or territory Work Schedule: 0730-1600, Monday through Friday.

Flexibility required based on the needs of the service. Telework: Ad-Hoc; telework may be approved on an intermittent basis at supervisory discretion in alignment with service needs and VHA policy. Virtual: This is not a virtual position. Relocation/Recruitment Incentives: Not Authorized Permanent Change of Station (PCS): Not Authorized

The role involves long periods of walking, standing, stooping, sitting, bending, pulling, and pushing.

Transferring patients and objects may be required; mechanical lifts are available. The incumbent may be exposed to infected patients, contaminated materials, isolation environments, invasive procedures, and occasionally combative patients due to delirium, dementia, or psychiatric conditions.

The NM must be flexible, mature, and able to perform effectively in stressful situations, shifting priorities based on patient needs. Annual Employee Health requirements (including TB screening) apply. Driving or riding in government vehicles may be required.

Duties include but not limited to: Keeps staff informed of Orlando VA Healthcare Systems administrative goals through facilitating both vertical and horizontal communication in a timely manner. Proves frequent supervision of nursing personnel assigned to them and evaluates their performance and competency.

Knowledgeable concerning the disciplinary process and keeps their supervisor abreast of such actions. Collaborates with the Nursing Officer of the Day as a key stakeholder in the assignment of the Float Pool staffing resources.

Responsible for all issues that affect nursing including standards of practice, credentialing, training, functional statement, position descriptions, proficiency reports, performance appraisals, policies, procedures, protocols, and competencies.

Ensures appropriate orientation, education and continuing professional development of nursing personnel supervised. Creates a positive work environment that enhances care delivery and professional development of clinically competent staff. Promotes a culturally divers workforce in which in the values and needs of all individuals are respected.

Enhances care outcomes by collaborating with members of interdisciplinary team to remove barriers and implement new evidence based cutting edge programs/processes. Engages in professional organizations to enhance leadership and career growth.

Adheres to ethical principles in decision making, fostering accountability at personal, organizational, and staff levels. Equips staff with tools for competent care and promotes an environment of accountability for high quality, cost effective outcomes.

Promotes alliances across the care continuum, building trust through active listening, engagement, and emotional intelligence. Contributes to the development of care delivery models and environmental design, ensuring evidence based, accessible, affordable patient care. Ensures compliance with accreditation and regulatory standards.

Aligns nursing/clinical objectives with organizational strategic outcomes, participating in strategy planning and execution. Provides peers with informal constructive feedback for improvement.

Demonstrates leadership in delivering and improving holistic care through collaborative strategies with others. Evaluates practice in an ongoing process, based on best evidence.

Registered Nurse (Germany) – Remote About Us Think Global - Expect Amazing! TalentWorldGroup is a revolutionary multilingual Contact Center. We are a truly people-focused company on a mission to reinvent professional home-based working and build the Workplace of the Future.

Position Overview We are currently qualifying candidates for an upcoming remote Registered Nurse project scheduled to start at the end of Summer / beginning of Fall. We are seeking Registered Nurses located in Germany with an active German RN license to support one of our premium international clients in the medical field.

This is a fully remote, work-from-home opportunity where you will provide professional support to patients and healthcare professionals following a comprehensive paid training program. Key Responsibilities
Resolve customer inquiries, complaints, and requests, including technical or clinical information while working within a defined scope of practice.
Serve as a telecare clinical contact for patients, clinical staff, and internal team members.
Support escalations from the Level 1 Technical Services team when required.
Follow all environmental, health, and safety procedures and company policies.
Act as a liaison between customers, TalentWorldGroup, and the client.
Help maintain the accuracy of online knowledge bases, troubleshooting guides, and reference materials.
Identify opportunities to improve customer experience, equipment reliability, and treatment quality.
Complete scheduled and unscheduled outbound calls to telecare patients and clinical collaborators.
Receive inbound calls from telecare patients and clinical collaborators.
Analyze treatment data and identify clinical, user, or product-related trends.
Document all interactions accurately and share relevant information with appropriate stakeholders.
Training Program
8 weeks of paid remote training
Covers technical support, systems, and treatment analysis.
Training Schedule: Monday to Friday, 4:00 PM – 10:00 PM CEST (6 hours training)- ﻿For six weeks with a two weeks nesting period
Working Schedule
Operating Hours: Monday to Friday, between 9:00 AM and 6:00 PM CET
Expected workload: Approximately 2 hours per day
Fully remote from Germany

€26/hour during training
€28/hour after successful completion of training

Currently living in Germany
Active Registered Nurse (RN) license issued in Germany
Nursing degree (BSc or equivalent nursing diploma)
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in German and English
2–4 years of customer service or contact center experience is preferred but not required
Experience with dialysis therapy is an advantage but not mandatory

Broadband internet connection (Ethernet/LAN, minimum 50 Mbps)
Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5 or higher

Wired USB headset
Windows 11 or later
100% remote work from home

Paid training
Long-term freelance cooperation
Career development opportunities
Performance-based gamification program, including bonus opportunities and paid leave hours
Recruitment Process We have already started qualifying candidates for this project. As training places are limited and the project is expected to begin at the end of Summer / beginning of Fall, we encourage interested Registered Nurses to apply as early as possible to complete the qualification process. Die Langzeitpflege lebt von Beziehung: Sie begleiten Menschen über lange Zeit, kennen ihre Gewohnheiten und bauen echtes Vertrauen auf. Dabei begleiten Sie auch komplexe, chronische Verläufe – mit Ruhe und Kontinuität statt Hektik.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?
Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.
Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Working Environment & Core Schedule
Client / Practice Focus: OB/GYN & Women's Health
Status: Full-Time (40 Hours / Week)
Schedule: Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST (US Eastern Standard Time)
Top 3 Daily Tasks
Clinical Patient Triage & Call Management: Handle incoming clinical phone calls, assess patient symptoms according to established OB/GYN protocols, and provide appropriate guidance.
AthenaHealth EHR Inbox Management: Review, prioritize, and manage physician inboxes, lab results, and patient portal messages—filtering non-urgent items and routing actionable tasks.
Urgent Escalation & Protocol Guidance: Swiftly identify high-risk or provider-level clinical concerns (e.g., severe obstetric or gynecologic symptoms) and escalate them directly to attending physicians.

OB/GYN Clinical Triage: Evaluate patient concerns over the phone, applying specialized protocols for prenatal, postpartum, and general gynecological care.
AthenaHealth EHR Inbox Optimization: Categorize, respond to, and clear prescription refill requests, routine lab notifications, and non-urgent patient inquiries inside Athena.
Patient Follow-Up & Guidance: Contact patients to deliver routine lab/test results, explain physician-approved care plans, and answer clinical questions.

Administrative Operations: Provide comprehensive clinical administrative support to maximize the full 40-hour weekly schedule and streamline clinic operations.

Licensure: Active, unencumbered USRN License .
Clinical Specialty Expertise (CRITICAL): Proven clinical experience in OB/GYN, Women’s Health, L&D, or Outpatient Gynecology . OB/GYN expertise is strictly prioritized.
Communication & Demeanor: Exceptional verbal and written English communication with clear, neutral pronunciation for high-stakes patient triage calls.
Software Proficiency: Direct hands-on experience navigating and managing the inbox/messaging workflows within AthenaHealth EHR .
Remote Workspace Setup: A private, HIPAA-compliant home office with a reliable computer, high-speed internet, and a clear headset.

Bilingual Skills: Professional fluency in Spanish is a plus, provided OB/GYN clinical requirements are fully met.
Ideal Candidate Profile
You are an articulate, sharp USRN who understands the clinical urgency and nuances of OB/GYN patient care. You navigate AthenaHealth effortlessly, take pride in managing provider inboxes, and know exactly how to protect physician time while giving patients compassionate, protocol-driven care.

Die Stiftung Eichholz bietet 47 Wohn- und Beschäftigungsplätze für Menschen mit einer psychischen Beeinträchtigung und/oder einer Abhängigkeitserkrankung an.

In 30 Einzelzimmern, 2 Studios, 12 Wohngruppenplätzen, 3 Aussenwohngruppenplätzen und einem Atelier unterstützen wir die Dienstleistungsnutzenden individuell, fachkompetent und lösungsorientiert in der Gestaltung ihres Alltags.

Es besteht für die Dienstleistungsnutzenden auch die Möglichkeit an einer internen Beschäftigung in der Küche, Hauswirtschaft oder Hauswartung teilzunehmen. Die interne Beschäftigung wird im Rahmen der Tagesstruktur ohne Lohn geführt und steht auch externen Personen zur Verfügung.
